# Hardened Leather: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10088/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: A sleeveless fitted vest of smooth dark-brown hardened leather with a high round neck; an olive-bronze leather panel crossing diagonally from the near shoulder over the chest, edged with a row of small brass studs; a rolled leather hem band with brass studs..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A sleeveless fitted vest of smooth dark-brown hardened leather with a high round neck; an olive-bronze leather panel crossing diagonally from the near shoulder over the chest, edged with a row of small brass studs; a rolled leather hem band with brass studs.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10088/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input ordering: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the exact edit target; image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference; image 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference only. Preserve the guide's unusual view orientations exactly, without rearranging them. Olive-bronze chest panel and hem bands are LEATHER, so green in mask; only brass studs are red. All inner leather also green. Output only the requested atlas.
CORRECTION REQUIREMENT: All ten silhouettes must match the guide exactly. Mask rows must have perfectly clean transparent exterior with ZERO green speckles or spill outside the original silhouettes. The holes in all views MUST remain transparent, especially the central oval holes in row 3. Do not fill holes green. Mask leather is uniformly pure #00FF00 with no lines, seams, tonal variations or shading; studs uniformly #FF0000. Preserve the original guide alpha boundaries. Paint rows should have subtle leather surface detail matching reference, without lighting gradients. Exact 3:4 canvas.
